definitions.explanation: a weapon for shooting arrows, consisting of a curved piece of wood or other flexible material with a string stretched between its ends
a stick with horsehair stretched between its ends, used to play string instruments like violin

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{弓道|きゅうどう}では{長|なが}い{弓|ゆみ}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Long bows are used in Japanese kyudo (archery).
To prepare the bow and arrows.

examples.japanese: バイオリンの{弓|ゆみ}を{松脂|まつやに}で{手入|てい}れする。
examples.english: To apply rosin to the violin bow.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese archery ({弓道|きゅうどう}) uses asymmetric longbows ({和弓|わきゅう}) that are among the longest in the world.

RELATED TERMS:
- {弓道|きゅうどう} (Japanese archery, "the way of the bow")
- {弓|ゆみ}{矢|や} (bow and arrow)
- {矢|や} (arrow)
- {的|まと} (target)
- {洋弓|ようきゅう} (Western archery)

COMPOUND READING:
When used in compound words, often read as きゅう: {弓道|きゅうどう}
